new_objections.title: transportation.json has existing cost_local field with correct CNY values — BA ignores it and prescribes blind x8.05 multiplication
new_objections.details: BA spec R10 and AC8 instruct dev to multiply ALL cost values in transportation.json by 8.05. However, QA verified transportation.json already has BOTH cost (EUR) and cost_local (correct CNY from Gaode Maps API). The actual EUR-to-CNY ratios vary per route (5.0 to 7.5, NOT 8.05). Examples: airport express cost=5, cost_local=35 (ratio 7.0); Didi Mutianyu cost=15, cost_local=110 (ratio 7.33); Beijing-Datong HSR cost=20, cost_local=148 (ratio 7.4); Beijing-Chengdu flight cost=328, cost_local=2380 (ratio 7.26). Blind x8.05 produces wrong values: airport becomes 40.25 (correct is 35), HSR becomes 161 (correct is 148). BA makes ZERO mention of cost_local field anywhere. Accommodation.json does NOT have cost_local — only cost — so x8.05 is appropriate there only.
new_objections.recommendation: Amend R10: (A) accommodation.json — multiply cost by 8.05 (no cost_local exists, correct as-is). (B) transportation.json — replace cost with existing cost_local value, then remove cost_local field. Do NOT multiply by 8.05 — authoritative CNY values already exist. Update AC8 transportation assertions accordingly.
